title: Geometry of finite normalized point-blowup towers
statement: Let $X$ be an integral Noetherian excellent scheme of finite Krull dimension $d\geq1$ [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], where Noetherian means a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings and excellence is imposed on every affine open. Put $X_0=X^\nu$, the normalization of $X$ in its function field [def-sc-normalization, def-sc-function-field]. Given a finite tower $X_n\to\cdots\to X_0$ in which each arrow is the blowup at a reduced closed point followed by normalization in its function field [def-nagata-global-blowup], every $X_j$ is integral, normal, excellent, Noetherian, and of dimension $d$ [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. All normalization morphisms used here are finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. The composite $X_n\to X$ is projective in the projective-bundle sense [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism] and induces an isomorphism of function fields. If $U\subseteq X$ is a normal open subscheme and every chosen center maps into $X\setminus U$, the restriction $X_n\times_X U\to U$ is an isomorphism [def-pc-fibre-product]. In particular, for $n=0$ normalization is an isomorphism over every normal open. No regularity of $X_n$ and no existence of a tower with regular endpoint is asserted.
